messages.text: Hi, please have a read of my profile and let me know if I'm a suitable Tennant please!

Jess, hey, I see U guys are still looking. Look.... I know 44 seems old and boring but babe I promise I can pull out some classic moves on the dance floor that will have U in stitches! I have updated my profile a bit in the "promise I'm not ya mum" section to show U I really am no boring old fart and U won't feel cramped with me in Ur house. 
Please have another look and at least meet me so I can show U I'm not so bad!
